name: Jagged Knife Hexer
description: A staff-wielding bandit in a cloak adorned with magical paraphernalia, using curses to vex their foes.

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.description: Choose a target within Far range and temporarily Curse them. While the target is Cursed, you can mark a Stress when that target rolls with Hope to make the roll be with Fear instead.

abilities.name: Chaotic Flux
abilities.description: Make an attack against up to three targets within Very Close range. Mark a Stress to deal 2d6+3 magic damage to targets the Hexer succeeded against.
